texto.muro: the bare warm-white lime-plaster wall of the working production studio, with fine mineral texture

escena: SCENE (creative direction review of an unbranded food campaign in a working Santiago production studio, late afternoon): a genuinely wide 35mm documentary camera view, camera low at the near edge of a long proofing table, with the two people placed in the MIDDLE THIRD of the frame and visibly smaller than a close portrait. The TOP 30% is only the uninterrupted bare warm-white lime-plaster wall, softly and evenly daylit, with its real mineral texture; the window, people, table, equipment and prints begin BELOW this clear top area. Julio and Nexa stand side by side deciding between large photographic key-visual proofs laid across the table. Just as Nexa draws one short correction on a proof with a small vivid orange grease pencil, Julio points to the matching gap in the sequence. One of the substantial printed proofs nearest their hands contains a clean, saturated AZURE BLUE (#0375DB) art-directed color field, a real ink-on-paper part of the work, clearly visible as about 5% of the entire photograph; this is the brand blue carrier, not clothing, a mug or a decorative prop. The orange pencil is the only small story accent; no lime or other saturated accent. Julio wears a faded olive linen shirt with sleeves rolled up; Nexa wears a fine sand-colored cotton knit and cream trousers. No jackets, blazers or navy-blue clothes. Both concentrate on the proof, never on camera. Crisp angled natural sunlight cuts across their hands and paper without crossing the bare upper wall; warm-neutral skin and white balance, detailed highlights, neutral shadows. A folded unbranded camera tripod and rolled neutral paper in the distant soft background reveal a real creative production studio, never a glass-boardroom meeting. Keep all objects and faces away from the left and right outer edges. Everything unbranded; no legible words, letters, numerals or logos anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the charcoal-black matte lid of a closed camera flight case between the camera and the proofing table, its edge almost touching the lens
lecho.tono: DARK near black, charcoal matte equipment material in shade with subtle real texture, without bright edges
